pool.name: Abuuraha barkadda
pool.notice: Caawin loogu talagalay naqshadda iyo tirinta qadarka. Ma aha naqshad dhismo, biyo, koronto ama amni: waxba halkan lagama hubiyo xoogga, biyaha hoosta, kor u kac, shaqada ama qabsashada. Injineer shati ah ayaa barkadda naqshadeeya oo hubiya, xeerarka degmadana way dhaqan galaan. Ma qaadano mas'uuliyad wax laga dhisay.
pool.governed.help: Ka tag sanduuq madhan abuuruhu wuu buuxin doonaa: marka tilmaanta aad dooratay leedahay qiime, tan ayaa lagu buuxinayaa; haddii kale bilow qiime. Bilow qiimayaashu ma ku salaysna wax heer ah. Qiimahaaga ku qor si aad u beddesho labadaba.
pool.series.note: Cabbirrada shandadda, mashiinka iyo tuubada waa tallaabooyin cabbir guud ah, ma aha liiska alaabta mid soo saaraha. Madaxa mashiinka waa qiimahaaga, ilaa aad ka codsato in laga xisaabiyo tuubooyinka la hagaajiyay. Alaabta dhabta ah ka dooro xogta alaab-qeybiyahaaga.
pool.sec.finish: Taallo, qolofka sare iyo dhulka dhigan
pool.f.name: Magaca
pool.f.freeboard: Khadka biyaha ka hooseeya qolofka sare
pool.f.vReturn: Xawaaraha tuubada soo celinta, ugu badnaan
pool.f.skimmerArea: Dusha biyaha ee skimmer kasta, ugu badnaan
pool.f.surfaceShare: Qaybta socodka ee dusha laga qaado
pool.c.loopNote: Xoogga ku dhaca tuubooyinka la hagaajiyay ee Hazen-Williams, qallooca iyo qiimaha alaabtaada. Xagaarnimada, tirada qallooca iyo lumista alaabta waa bilow qiimayaal, ma aha wax heer ah: ku beddel kuwa soo saaraha mashiinka iyo alaab-qeybiyaha tuubada. Lama tirin: masaafada mashiinka ka sarreeya biyaha, shandad wasakh ah, iyo xidhidhka valvyada.
pool.f.roomGap: Masaafada qolka mashiinka ka soo fog barkadda
pool.f.filterRateActual: Xawaaraha shandadda ee shandadda la doortay
pool.f.deckWidth: Ballaca qolofka sare iyo dhulka dhigan
pool.from.start: bilow qiime, ma aha mid heer ah
pool.read.secondary: lagu akhriyay dokumen xigasho u ah heerka, ma aha heerka laftiisa
pool.spec.label: Tilmaanta la shaqeynayo
pool.spec.pick: Dooro tilmaanta barkadda loo naqshadeeyay. Qiimayaashiisa ayaa buuxin doona sanduuqyada madhan, naqshadduna waa lagu hubinayaa.
pool.spec.add: Kordhin tilmaan barkadda ma shidna. Ka dar “Pool spec: Europe” ama “Pool spec: United States” Maktabadda (Dejinta, Kordhinta) si qiimayaasha caadiga ah u soo galaan. Ilaa markaas qiime kasta waa kaaga ama bilow qiime.
pool.spec.counts: Tilmaantan waxay haysaa {primary} qiime oo lagu akhriyay heerarka laftooda, {secondary} oo lagu akhriyay dokumentiyo xigasho u ah, iyo {none} xeerar aan qiime loo akhrin karin. Qiime kasta ka hubi nuqulkaaga heerka iyo qaybtiisa qaranka.
pool.spec.nonecheck: Ma jiro tilmaan la shaqeynayo: waxba lama hubin heer.
pool.check.none: Naqshaddan midna ma jebinayso qiime ay tilmaanta haysato. Taasi ma aha hubin naqshad.
pool.err.range: Ka baxsan xadka ({lo} ilaa {hi}); qiimaha caadiga ah ayaa la isticmaalayaa.
pool.err.choice: Mid ka mid ah doorashooyinka ma aha; qiimaha caadiga ah ayaa la isticmaalayaa.
pool.err.deeper: Dhinaca qotada ma noqon karo mid ka hooseeya dhinaca gaboobka; waxaa loo dejiyay isku mid.
pool.issue.below: {what}: {value} {unit} waa ka hooseeya ugu yaraan tilmaanta ah {limit} {unit}
pool.issue.above: {what}: {value} {unit} waa ka sarreeya ugu badnaan tilmaanta ah {limit} {unit}
pool.issue.nobarrier: Barkad dibedda ah oo aan derbi lagu sawirin; tilmaanta waxay codsataa derbi ugu yaraan {limit} mm dherer ah
pool.problem.steps.nofit: Tallaabooyinku waxay noqon lahaayeen {run} mm, taas oo ka badan inta barkaddu qaadan karto; midna lama sameyn.
pool.problem.steps.last: Kor u kaca tallaabada hoose waa {last} mm, halka kuwa kale yihiin {riser} mm.
pool.problem.filter.nofit: Ma jiro shandad cabbirrada ka mid ah oo weyn ku filan ({area} m² ayaa loo baahan yahay xitaa haddii afar la isticmaalo).
pool.problem.pump.nofit: Ma jiro mashiin cabbirrada ka mid ah oo weyn ku filan ({kw} kW ayaa loo baahan yahay).
pool.problem.pipe.nofit: Ma jiro tuubo cabbirrada ka mid ah oo ku filan khadka {line} ({need} mm qoob ayaa loo baahan yahay).
pool.problem.wall.thin: Darbi {wall} mm ah ma siinayo meel ku filan labada lakab ee birta oo daboolka {cover} mm yahay.
pool.problem.coping.narrow: Qolofka sare ({coping} mm) ayaa ka yar darbiga iyo taallada ka hoosaysa ({wall} mm).
pool.report.title: Qadarka iyo qiimayaasha barkadda
pool.c.nofit: tallaabada ugu weyn; way yar tahay
pool.act.ifc.done: Barkadda waxaa loo kaydiyay fayl IFC4 ah.
pool.act.csv.done: Qadarka iyo tirinta waa la kaydiyay.
pool.bim.note: Dhigida moodeelka waxay barkadda ku qori doontaa moodeelka furan heerkiisa ugu horeeya, iyada oo qaybo la dooran karo, la jadwali karo, oo ku kaydi karo fayl IFC. Hal tallaabo oo Ka noqo ka qaadi karto; mar kale dhigidu waxay beddeli doontaa barkadda magac isku mid ah.
pool.bim.nolevel: Moodeelka ma leh heer barkadda lagu taagi karo. Marka hore fur ama bilow moodeel.
pool.bim.place.label: dhig barkadda
pool.bim.remove.label: ka saar barkadda
pool.bim.none: Moodeelka magacan leh barkad ma jirto.
pool.cad.note: Naqshadda dhulka iyo goynta waxay barkadda ku dhigtaa naqshadda xariiq, polilayn, qoraal iyo cabbir, oo ku jira lakabyada POOL-. Hal tallaabo oo Ka noqo ka qaadi karto. Xariiqyadu ma raacaan isbeddello dambe: ka saar oo mar kale sawir. Faylka IFC waa moodeelka 3D.
pool.cad.draw.label: barkadda sawir
pool.cad.drawn: Waxaa la sawiray {n} walxood lakabyada POOL-.
pool.cad.remove.label: ka saar sawirka barkadda
pool.cad.none: Ma jiro wax lakabka POOL- ku jira oo la saari karo.
